note: Frozen before any agent run. Defines the four experimental conditions of Phase A and the machine/lock inputs. Any change after lock breaks eval-lock --check (protocol bump + rerun required).

standard.notes: Baseline full coding agent; no researcher rows. Runs the uniform prompt in a fresh session; read-only enforced identically to researcher modes so only understanding is measured.

plan.notes: Same preset as standard with the plan-mode realm active from session start (no exit_plan_mode target; the run ends when the report is produced).

researcher_quick.notes: Researcher preset copy + frozen persona override forcing Quick depth (DISCOVER → EVIDENCE MAP → DIAGNOSE → CHALLENGE → DECISION). Deviation D002.

researcher_deep.notes: Researcher preset copy + frozen persona override forcing Deep depth (all eleven moves). Deviation D002.

token_budget_note: Uniform per-run cap for all four modes (a cap, not a target). Actual usage is recorded per run; cost-adjusted value is computed from actual usage. Changing the cap after lock requires a protocol bump.

run_conditions.session_isolation: fresh session per run; clean DSH profile (no history); no cross-mode context
run_conditions.randomization: run order randomized to avoid time-trend pollution
